value.rationale: The exact distribution of descendant sphere sizes over random multiset sources measures heterogeneity essential to unordered-symbol deletion-channel packing and decoding. A complete t=3 histogram all n,q, a rational finite-parameter variance for all t, and a sharp nondegenerate Gaussian fluctuation scale under the natural n/q finite-density limit go beyond isolated computations, a previous average, and trivial codebook bounds. No general coding capacity theorem is claimed.
